answer: Each interaction contributes reputation that decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so trust must be renewed through sustained, reciprocal honest service; brief bursts cannot preserve influence. In an EigenTrust-style matrix, a freshly spawned Sybil has few trusted incoming paths and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed credibility. Like pigment on velvet beside walnut, an identity’s label alone adds no weight: without established links and accumulated evidence, it cannot meet consensus thresholds.
